entities.name: Varghese Payyappilly Palakkappilly
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Varghese Payyappilly was an Indian Syro-Malabar priest from Kerala and the founder of the congregation of Sisters of the Destitute. He was declared Venerable by Pope Francis on 14 April 2018.
